Snacks

Date and peanut spoon

Gyümölcsös kanálkrém

12 months+ Replaced 15 min 4 portions

Not a daily food. Offer a few spoonfuls from twelve months, and only if peanut is already tolerated. Never a thick spoon of peanut butter on its own.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 4 Dates (Pitted, unsulphured, soaked until soft)
  • 2 teaspoons Smooth peanut butter (Stirred into the mash, never served thick on a spoon)
  • 30 g Fine oats (Softened in the mash)
  • 4 tablespoons Soaking water (Keeps the mix loose enough to spoon)

Allergens

peanutgluten

Method

  1. Soak the pitted dates in warm water until soft.
  2. Drain them and keep four tablespoons of the soaking water.
  3. Mash the dates with the oats, peanut butter, and soaking water until smooth and loose.
  4. Check the mash falls from a spoon rather than holding a stiff ball.
  5. Serve with a spoon.

Replaced

Energy balls are sticky, sweet, and a choking risk, and they often contain honey. This is not a daily food, because dates are free sugar.

Mash soaked dates with smooth peanut butter and oats into a spoonable mix, and serve it with a spoon rather than rolling hard balls. Keep it occasional from twelve months, and use no honey. A baby with severe eczema or a known egg allergy needs a clinician before the first peanut taste.
